gameFactor.viceNote: Vice is a WAYS game. PixiApp.ts:625 picks the factor by pay model: ways 0.98, scatterpays 0.99, lines 0.85, compact (<520px) 0.98. The 0.85 that used to sit here is the LINES branch and made the machine ~13% too small.

cap.note: the min() cap, also picked by pay model — Vice takes 1.7, not 1.3

sceneMargin.note: PixiApp.ts:613 — Vice subtracts 14px per side, not the 40px SCENE_MARGIN default

gameFactor.rule: scale = min(availW/(totalW+overhang), availH/totalH, cap[payModel]) * factor[payModel]; avail = screen - 2*sceneMargin[payModel] — PixiApp.ts:613,625

renderer.resolution: max(2, min(devicePixelRatio, 2)) = always exactly 2 (sharpness floor/cap — PixiApp.ts:328)

It was replaced by the universal CHAIN GAMES loader, which is platform branding and carries no per-game title, colour ramp or LOADING label. Building from the old values would reproduce a screen we deliberately removed.

audio.srcRule: oggFirst: [/audio/<id>.ogg, /audio/<id>.mp3]; otherwise [/audio/<id>.wav, /audio/<id>.ogg, /audio/<id>.mp3]; unknown event volume fallback 0.7 (unused — all 20 registry events have explicit volumes)

uiSfx.rule: HTMLAudio, follows master mute + volume (effective = vol * sm.volume)

mixingRules.marqueeStart: duck('ambient-music', 300ms fade to 0, keeps looping muted) + play('win-screen-music')  [our internal event id is win-marquee; it ships to the dev as win-screen-music, which is the only spelling in preset.audio.events]
mixingRules.marqueeEnd: fadeStop('win-screen-music', smooth ? 900 : 260 ms) + unduck('ambient-music', smooth ? 700 : 400 ms)  [the duck MUST release — if the exclusive group is still keyed on the old name the ambient bed never returns and it reads as hanging marquee music]
mixingRules.duckDefaults: SoundManager duck default 350ms, unduck default 450ms (overridden by the explicit values above)
mixingRules.reelSpinLoopFade: fadeStop 450ms the moment reel 0 stops; safety fadeStop 90ms when all reels stopped
mixingRules.scatterDingLadder: rate = 1 + min(n,3)*0.14 per scatter in one landing sequence; counter resets after 4000ms silence
mixingRules.winStepChimeLadder: rate = 1 + min(index,8)*0.09 per connection (vice keeps the chime ladder; no per-symbol quips)
mixingRules.winStingerGate: state-driven win-small/normal/big/mega thresholds 2x/10x/50x bet; ALL suppressed when ratio >= minBigWin 15 (marquee owns audio); coin-chime accents at 200/600ms (big) +1100/1700/2300ms (mega) — moot at design volume 0
mixingRules.ambientAutoplay: play on mount + pointerdown/keydown unlock + first-spin fallback; exclusive flag makes double play a no-op
mixingRules.teaseArc: onTeaseStart: duck('ambient-music',350) + play('tease-riser'); onTeaseEnd(hit): fadeStop('tease-riser', hit?120:60) + unduck(500) + play(hit ? 'free-spin-trigger' : 'tease-miss')

audio._source: src/data/viceSoundPreset.json — Noski's finished mix, seeded at App.tsx boot. THIS is the live table.
audio.supersedes: This block previously carried the pre-Audio-Studio registry DEFAULTS from src/audio/defaultSoundConfig.ts — a second, contradicting volume table inside the same preset, with ten wrong values (ambient-music 0.06 against a live 0.35, free-spin-trigger 1.0 against 0.59, spin-start 0.78 against 0.47, reel-stop 0.58 against 0.16, coin-chime 0.3 against 0.53, wild-land 0.8 against 0.09, wild-expand 0.85 against 0.12, near-miss-tease 0.4 against 0, tease-riser 0.4 against 0.26, tease-miss 0.45 against 0.26). If two tables ever reappear, preset.audio.events is the one the dev loads and this one is documentation of the same values.
